name: What should I consider when planning cabinet placement for a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when planning cabinet placement for a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning cabinet placement for a kitchen remodel, consider the 'work triangle' concept (sink, stove, refrigerator) to ensure efficient workflow. Also, think about ergonomic accessibility, ensuring frequently used items are within easy reach. Storage needs are crucial; factor in pantry space, specialized drawers, and appliance garages. For homes in the East Bay, where diverse architectural styles are common, consider how cabinet placement will integrate with existing windows, doorways, and structural elements to maximize both functionality and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider the work triangle, ergonomic accessibility, and storage needs when planning cabinet placement. Integrate with existing architectural elements for functionality and aesthetics.
